item.title: NVIDIA Commits to 20-Year AI Factory Site Securing $150B-Plus GPU Deployments
item.summary: NVIDIA announced a 20-year commitment to secure 4.25 gigawatts of land, power, and shell capacity at the PORTS-Pike campus in Ohio for OpenAI's AI factory, with each GPU generation representing $150B–$200B in NVIDIA revenue and a total OpenAI compute pipeline the company estimates at roughly $600 billion through 2030.
